<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0"
         xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
         xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 http://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd">
    <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>

    <parent>
        <artifactId>springgear-build</artifactId>
        <groupId>org.ousui.springgear</groupId>
        <version>2.1.0-SNAPSHOT</version>
    </parent>
    <artifactId>springgear-parent</artifactId>
    <packaging>pom</packaging>

    <licenses>
        <license>
            <name>Apache License 2.0</name>
            <url>https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0</url>
            <distribution>repo</distribution>
        </license>
    </licenses>
    <developers>
        <developer>
            <name>ousui</name>
            <url>https://ousui.org</url>
            <email>x@ousui.org</email>
        </developer>
    </developers>
    <scm>
        <connection>scm:git:https://github.com/ousui/springgear.git</connection>
        <url>https://github.com/ousui/springgear/</url>
        <developerConnection>scm:git:git@github.com:ousui/springgear.git</developerConnection>
        <tag>HEAD</tag>
    </scm>
    <issueManagement>
        <url>https://github.com/ousui/springgear/issues</url>
    </issueManagement>

    <properties>
        <!-- 常用版本 -->
        <ver.spring>5.3.39</ver.spring>

        <ver.guava>20.0</ver.guava>

        <ver.slf4j>2.0.5</ver.slf4j>
        <ver.log4j2>2.19.0</ver.log4j2>
    </properties>

    <dependencyManagement>

        <dependencies>

            <dependency>
                <groupId>org.ousui.springgear</groupId>
                <artifactId>springgear-bom</artifactId>
                <version>${project.version}</version>
                <scope>import</scope>
                <type>pom</type>
            </dependency>

            <dependency>
                <groupId>org.springframework</groupId>
                <artifactId>spring-framework-bom</artifactId>
                <version>${ver.spring}</version>
                <scope>import</scope>
                <type>pom</type>
            </dependency>

            <dependency>
                <groupId>com.google.guava</groupId>
                <artifactId>guava</artifactId>
                <version>${ver.guava}</version>
            </dependency>

        </dependencies>

    </dependencyManagement>

    <dependencies>
        <!-- test case junit -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.junit.jupiter</groupId>
            <artifactId>junit-jupiter-api</artifactId>
            <version>5.7.0</version>
            <scope>test</scope>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.junit.jupiter</groupId>
            <artifactId>junit-jupiter-engine</artifactId>
            <version>5.7.0</version>
            <scope>test</scope>
        </dependency>
        <!-- /test case junit -->

        <!-- jdk 11+ -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>javax.annotation</groupId>
            <artifactId>javax.annotation-api</artifactId>
            <version>1.3.2</version>
            <optional>true</optional>
            <scope>compile</scope>
        </dependency>

        <!-- log -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.slf4j</groupId>
            <artifactId>slf4j-api</artifactId>
            <version>${ver.slf4j}</version>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.slf4j</groupId>
            <artifactId>jcl-over-slf4j</artifactId>
            <version>${ver.slf4j}</version>
        </dependency>

        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.slf4j</groupId>
            <artifactId>jul-to-slf4j</artifactId>
            <version>${ver.slf4j}</version>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.slf4j</groupId>
            <artifactId>log4j-over-slf4j</artifactId>
            <version>${ver.slf4j}</version>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.slf4j</groupId>
            <artifactId>osgi-over-slf4j</artifactId>
            <version>${ver.slf4j}</version>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.apache.logging.log4j</groupId>
            <artifactId>log4j-api</artifactId>
            <version>${ver.log4j2}</version>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.apache.logging.log4j</groupId>
            <artifactId>log4j-core</artifactId>
            <version>${ver.log4j2}</version>
        </dependency>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.apache.logging.log4j</groupId>
            <artifactId>log4j-slf4j2-impl</artifactId>
            <version>${ver.log4j2}</version>
        </dependency>
        <!--/ log -->

        <!-- lombok -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.projectlombok</groupId>
            <artifactId>lombok</artifactId>
            <version>1.18.30</version>
            <scope>provided</scope>
        </dependency>

        <!-- /基础依赖，用于所有模块 -->
    </dependencies>
</project>

blocks.classification: Incomplete migration rather than successful delivery.
blocks.handling: Retain exact failure and source result; correct the bounded migration or environment and retry.
blocks.observable_result: No false VFY-ready state or hidden failed tests.
blocks.recovery: Resume the same valid attempt or use the formal rework path without deleting evidence.
blocks.trigger: Source precondition, compilation, test discovery or compatibility assertion fails.

blocks.consistency_or_atomicity: Each source effect has a persistent checkpoint and immutable resource result.
blocks.failure_handling: Leave failed checks visible; no Maven deployment, Git update or external system mutation.
blocks.idempotency: Completed writes are not replayed on confirmation or retry.
blocks.order_and_condition: Align POMs before adding tests; all writes bind current expected content.
blocks.resource_or_effect: Declared Maven reactor files and isolated test/build outputs

steps.expected_result: POMs explicitly target JDK21 and retain public Java source.
steps.failure_boundary: Any incompatible source, toolchain or test result prevents completion.
logic: Read exact selected design and current resource baseline.
Apply only declared compatibility or regression files with content preconditions.
Execute bounded checks and retain the complete current immutable source result.
steps.purpose: Align the reactor build and processor dependencies for JDK21.
steps.transaction_boundary: One dependency-ordered source migration increment; isolated local build outputs only.
